$comment: Ceilings for the exact shipped lyraThemeBootstrap string, measured raw and with gzip level 9. Reviewed mode-only restoration adds validated factory/script configuration while preserving host-owned visual axes, inline styles and ownership records. The build enforces the reviewed measurements plus 2% rounded-up headroom; bundle re-minification is deliberately excluded. Per-axis restoration (an axis list in restore / data-lr-theme-restore, leaving unlisted axes to the host) measures 18,088 raw and 6,602 gzip bytes.
